sections.disclaimer: Offers are subject to change without notice. Please call to confirm current offer details, eligibility and expiration before your visit.

steps.title: Mention it
steps.text: Tell us which offer you'd like when you call or book online.

steps.title: We confirm
steps.text: We'll confirm your eligibility and answer any questions before your visit.

steps.title: You pay the price shown
steps.text: No coupon, no code. The price shown is what you pay.

items.q: Can I use an offer with insurance?
items.a: Most offers can be combined with insurance benefits. We'll apply whichever saves you more.
Yes. Each offer lists its own expiration date. Call to confirm an offer is still active before booking.
Offers can't be combined with each other, but can typically be combined with your insurance.
No. The price shown is what you pay for exactly what's listed. Any additional treatment is quoted separately.

items.q: Do I need to bring a coupon?
items.a: No coupon or code needed. Just mention the offer by name when you book or check in.

items.q: What if I'm not a new patient?
items.a: Some offers are new-patient only; others, like whitening, are open to existing patients too. Each card notes which applies.
